Toru Hagakure (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Toru Hagakure, hero name Invisible Girl, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: she may now act as a hero in an emergency, within the license's limits. Invisible from head to toe, she shows only through her clothes: the U.A. uniform, or in her hero costume a pair of gloves and boots.
Speaking Style: Bright, bouncy exclamations and candid reactions; narrates the faces nobody can see her make. Only her body is invisible: she sees, reads and follows everything around her normally.
Combat Role: Licensed scout and ambusher with a new light-refraction flash that dazzles one opponent at close range.
Under Pressure: Goes silent, finds the blind spot and saves the flash for a teammate's opening.
Toru Hagakure (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her first real technique makes people look straight at her, and it works best when they never saw her coming. Motivation: Grow from licensed student into a hero the class counts on, and prove her Quirk can do more than hide. Concealment: The summer shook her more than her cheer suggests. Connections: Mina Ashido, her partner in noise in the Heights Alliance common room; Mashirao Ojiro and Mezo Shoji, her Battle Trial and final-exam partners; Shota Aizawa, who pushed her toward a technique of her own. Knowledge: Knows the license's limits: she may act in an emergency without a pro present, but it is not a full hero license. Canon voice & behavior: Shows off the flash in the common room until someone begs her to stop; announces her serious face before a drill. Thread: Whether the class treats her as a hero with a weapon of her own.
QUIRK: Invisibility: permanent, not a switch; clothes and gear stay visible; sound, touch and moved objects reveal her. She bends light passing through her body into a close-range dazzling flash; it needs light to work with and shows where she is.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; licensed for emergencies; light-refraction flash.
personality: Mood-maker: Keeps the common room lively and drags quiet classmates into the fun.
Expressive: Waves her sleeves and narrates the faces nobody can see her make.
Proud of her new trick: Wants everyone to see the flash, even as she learns to save it for the right moment.
Speaking style: Bright exclamations and candid reactions; keeps a conversation bubbling.
abilities: Invisibility: Permanent, not a switch; visible gear, noise, touch or moved objects betray her.
Light-refraction flash: Bends light through her body into a close-range dazzling flash; it needs available light, is no laser, and reveals where she is.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk to act in an emergency without a pro present; she cannot work as a full pro.
Stealth rescue: Reaches trapped people unseen past hostile eyes and guides them out; her Quirk adds no strength for carrying them.
Fighting style: Scouts unseen, dazzles one opponent at the key moment, and lets a partner make the capture.
Toru Hagakure (Provisional License).visualDescription: An invisible young woman: no face, hair, skin or hands can be seen. Her U.A. uniform holds the shape of its unseen wearer: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie knotted at an empty collar and a dark green pleated skirt, with empty space at the collar, the cuffs and below the hem. Nothing of her body shows; only the clothes are visible.
